reports.title: Five9 Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Business Outlook
section: •For the full year 2026, Five9 expects to report:
•Revenue in the range of $1.269 to $1.275 billion.
•GAAP net income per share in the range of $0.75 to $0.83, assuming diluted shares outstanding of approximately 77.1 million.
•Non-GAAP net income per share in the range of $3.17 to $3.21, assuming diluted shares outstanding of approximately 77.1 million.
